package main
import "sort"
var _ = sort.Strings
func solve(x map[string]any) any {out:=map[string]float64{};for k,v:=range x["stock"].(map[string]any){out[k]=v.(float64)};for _,raw:=range x["reservations"].([]any){r:=raw.(map[string]any);k:=r["sku"].(string);if _,ok:=out[k];ok&&r["expires"].(float64)>x["now"].(float64){out[k]-=r["quantity"].(float64)}};for k,v:=range out{if v<0{out[k]=0}};return out}
